notes: Inbound via self-serve signup (developer sandbox) 2026-03-01. CTO (Rohit Patel) called 2026-03-04 — primary asks: SOC2 evidence, SSO (SAML) integration, and rough VPC pricing. Company profile: seed-stage payments fintech building merchant dashboard + dispute automation. Wants hosted API initially to iterate quickly; 'VPC-curious'—they flagged VPC/Private for later when processing sensitive chargebacks. Cost sensitive: target $0.0006/token equivalent; willing to test quantized models for cost. Latency SLO: p99 <200ms for chat support flows; throughput modest (peak ~30 concurrent agents). Prefers open/quantized models but will consider Redwood verified variants; wants automatic fallback to smaller models during spikes. Security: must export audit logs to their SIEM, SSO via SAML + SCIM, and data retention controls for chargeback evidence. Quote from CTO: "Need SOC2 proof before we put any customer PII into a vendor; otherwise we keep everything on-hosted but encrypted." AE notes: very responsive, timeline is aggressive (POC in 3 weeks). SE to demo streaming + token cost breakdown. Legal will own contract review — asked for SOC2 summary and data processing addendum.

use_case_summary: Aurumly will use hosted Redwood API for merchant support chat and automated dispute reconciliation. Primary flows: (1) embeddings-based doc search across receipts and dispute logs for fast agent answers; (2) chat assistant for merchant-facing troubleshooting with streaming responses; (3) reranking candidate reason codes for dispute automation. Requirements: low p99 latency, exportable audit logs, SSO via SAML, SOC2 attestation or equivalent evidence, and clear cost per call metrics for budgeting.
